isoSlideIn.description: Element enters from isometric angle — slides in at 30° from source vector
isoSlideIn.definition: @keyframes isoSlideIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-30px) translateY(-15px) rotateX(5deg); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0) translateY(0) rotateX(0); } }

isoBobble.description: Slow continuous y-axis float simulating isometric model breathing
isoBobble.definition: @keyframes isoBobble { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) rotateX(0deg); } 50% { transform: translateY(-4px) rotateX(1.5deg); } }

isoAssemble.description: Structural layer assembly — element slides up and fades in for staggered sequential builds
isoAssemble.definition: @keyframes isoAssemble { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

isoDepthPop.description: Card entry with perspective depth — scales from slightly recessed position
isoDepthPop.definition: @keyframes isoDepthPop { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.95) perspective(600px) translateZ(-20px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) perspective(600px) translateZ(0); } }

reducedMotion: All animation durations collapse to 1ms; final composed state preserved
